answer: Admission by escrow staircase: to earn a higher transaction tier an identity pays a marble deposit at each rung into a terrace vault that unlocks only for that identity per cycle. Rungs cannot be skipped, pooled or transferred, so an attacker wanting N sybils at usable capacity must walk each up the staircase, paying every rung, while an honest agent climbs once and reuses its tier. The wharf auditor binds each vault to one key, so the bill grows linearly with N: no bulk rate, no pre-funding a batch, no reset via fresh identities.
